novel_mechanics_found: Confirmed the projected symmetric-box rule: after F advances the lit-pad phase and B teleports to the east pad, a 6-spell cast adjacent to the 6cc6 box destroys it, removes the remote color-12 shaft barrier, and spawns a +10 energy pickup. Also grounded that B alone does not rotate away from the currently lit target in this trajectory; the reliable routing primitive is F then B, with the observed target order east, southwest, junction. Color-5 background is impassable despite looking empty, so the cleared shaft must be entered from the junction pad rather than walked to from the east box.
narrative: The cumulative banked prefix was replayed from a fresh reset and reached levels_completed=5 twice, including an optimized rendered-frame-only replay costing 125 calls. On L6 I reproduced the prior partial, broke both the 6dd6-linked and 6cc6-linked obstacles, collected both energy pickups, and decoded the remaining pad route. The final optimized attempt exhausted the exact 700-call campaign budget while trying F-to-B routing through east, southwest, and junction; energy reached zero during the last shaft approach and the frame became GAME_OVER before any L6 win, so no new level is claimed and no reproduction gate was run.
gotchas: The resolver-selected sc25 plan only contains the L1 sequence; the actual L2-L5 cumulative prefix is experiment_4468.SC25_PLANS_BY_LEVEL[5].
The repository apply helper reads env._game to settle animations, so this probe used only rendered-frame stability and direct action outcomes to comply with the hidden-state restriction.

Completed spells take effect on the final cast-cell action; replay can wait only after completed spells instead of after every selector/cell toggle, reducing the fresh L5 prefix from 217 to 125 env.step calls.
F followed by B is the grounded way to advance the pad phase and teleport; repeated B casts target the same lit southwest pad and waste energy.
After the east 6cc6 box is broken, do not try to walk left through color-5 background. Return via F then B to the junction pad and enter the cleared x=33..36 shaft from there.

Energy often drops by two for cast-cell and blocked-move actions. A nominal 14-row bar was insufficient for two spell patterns plus the shaft walk; at zero the rendered grid becomes shape (0,) and frame.levels_completed reports 0.

The clean projected finish after the first pickup is: F+B to east, three left moves, 6-spell, one left move for +10, then F+B to southwest, F+B to junction, and route into the shaft. It needs additional energy optimization before it can win.
